requirements.title: MINLOC argument restrictions
requirements.definition: ARRAY shall be an integer, real, or character array; DIM shall be an in-range integer scalar; MASK shall be logical and conformable; KIND shall be a scalar integer constant expression; BACK shall be a logical scalar.

pending.MINLOC-ARRAY-integer-real-or-character-a: Positive source controls use integer, exact real, and character arrays; source-control mutations use logical ARRAY or scalar ARRAY and claim no diagnostic facet.
pending.MINLOC-DIM-integer-scalar-in-range: Positive source controls use DIM=1 and DIM=2 for rank-two ARRAY; source-control mutations use nonscalar, noninteger, zero, or too-large DIM values and claim no diagnostic facet.
pending.MINLOC-MASK-logical-conformable: Positive source controls use a logical MASK with ARRAY shape; source-control mutations use integer MASK or mismatched shape and claim no diagnostic facet.
pending.MINLOC-KIND-scalar-integer-constant-expr: Positive source controls use KIND=KIND(0); source-control mutations use noninteger or nonconstant KIND expressions and claim no diagnostic facet.
pending.MINLOC-BACK-logical-scalar: Positive source controls use BACK=.FALSE. and BACK=.TRUE.; a source-control mutation uses nonscalar BACK and claims no diagnostic facet.

requirements.title: MINLOC result kind, rank, and shape follow KIND and DIM
requirements.definition: MINLOC returns integer of the KIND value or default integer; without DIM it has rank one and size equal to ARRAY rank, and with DIM it has rank n-1 and ARRAY shape with the DIM extent removed.

pending.MINLOC-result-kind-from-KIND: Guarded plan probes an available nondefault integer kind, uses KIND set to that constant, and asserts KIND(MINLOC(...)) equals it; fallback KIND(0) control covers syntax without a nondefault-kind claim.
pending.MINLOC-result-default-integer-without-KI: Evaluate MINLOC([3,1,2]) without KIND and assert KIND(result)==KIND(0) together with exact location [2]; companion KIND=KIND(0) call guards the explicit path.
pending.MINLOC-dim-absent-rank-one-size-rank: For a 2x3 integer ARRAY, evaluate MINLOC without DIM, initialize a rank-one result to [-7,-7], and assert SIZE(result)==2 plus exact subscripts for a unique minimum.
pending.MINLOC-dim-present-rank-and-shape: For a 2x3 integer ARRAY, evaluate DIM=1 and DIM=2 controls and assert SHAPE results [3] and [2] with exact section locations; mutate DIM so the shape and values change.

requirements.title: MINLOC without DIM locates eligible minima and returns zeros for empty selections
requirements.definition: Without DIM, MINLOC returns subscripts of an ARRAY element equal to the eligible minimum, with zero subscripts for zero-size ARRAY or no true MASK elements.

pending.MINLOC-no-DIM-unmasked-minimum-subscript: Use RESHAPE([5,4,3,2,1,6],[2,3]) with unique minimum at subscript [1,3], initialize result to [-7,-7], and assert [1,3]; mutate the minimum location so the subscript oracle changes.
pending.MINLOC-no-DIM-subscript-ranges: For the same nonempty rank-two control, assert each returned subscript lies within 1..extent and equals the exact expected subscript; mutate the shape arrangement so a range-only check cannot pass alone.
pending.MINLOC-zero-size-array-returns-zeros: Use a rank-one integer ARRAY with size zero, initialize result to [-7], and assert [0]; pair with a nonempty companion [5,1] expected [2] so the zero result is not vacuous.
pending.MINLOC-mask-selects-true-elements: Use ARRAY=[1,2,0] with MASK=[.FALSE.,.TRUE.,.TRUE.] and assert [3]; mutate MASK to exclude the third element so the selected subscript changes.
pending.MINLOC-all-false-mask-returns-zeros: Use ARRAY=[1,2,3] with all-false MASK, initialize result to [-7], and assert [0]; pair with a one-true companion expected [2] so the zero result is not vacuous.

requirements.title: MINLOC with DIM reduces each selected section
requirements.definition: With DIM, rank-one ARRAY produces the first element of the corresponding no-DIM MINLOC result, and higher-rank ARRAY applies MINLOC to each selected rank-one section.

pending.MINLOC-DIM-rank-one-scalar-location: Evaluate MINLOC([5,-9,3], DIM=1) into an integer sentinel 777 and assert 2; mutate DIM omission in source review so the scalar result contract is load-bearing.

requirements.title: MINLOC tie handling follows first element order unless BACK is true
requirements.definition: A unique minimum returns its subscripts; tied minima return the first in array element order unless BACK is true, and BACK true returns the last in array element order.

pending.MINLOC-unique-minimum-returns-that-locat: Use ARRAY=[4,1,6,3], initialize result to [-7], and assert [2]; mutate the unique minimum to another position so the location changes.
pending.MINLOC-tie-first-with-BACK-absent-or-fal: Use ARRAY=[4,3,6,3], assert MINLOC without BACK and with BACK=.FALSE. both return [2]; mutate BACK to true so the tied location changes.
pending.MINLOC-tie-last-with-BACK-true: Use ARRAY=[4,3,6,3] with BACK=.TRUE. and assert [4]; mutate BACK to false so the tied location changes.
